firstLines: I'm writing about the Director of Inbound Logistics opening. I've spent seven years in freight and distribution, the last
four running inbound for a home goods retailer with three distribution centers and about $48M in yearly freight
When I joined Red Clay Hearth, on-time inbound delivery was 87% and nobody trusted the carrier numbers. I built a
weekly scorecard, sat down with each of our nine truckload carriers, and renegotiated every contract. On-time
delivery is now 95%, and we save about $2.1M a year.
Grocery is a different pace, and I know that. Before Red Clay Hearth I worked on 120 lanes at Brassmoor Freight,
many of them for food shippers, so I'm used to short windows and cold-chain rules.
I would welcome a conversation about the network changes you're planning for next year.
